messages:
marta: Heads up — Driftwood (hardware partner) asked for a sync on the EA program gating, NDA sign-off, and co-announcement sequencing. Can we align on benchmarks + press windows?

kai: I can cover perf knobs and ramp timeline. Need lab access dates and the specific model list you'll want us to run.

devon (Driftwood): Thanks — legal has a counterparty review in progress. We also need clarity on what telemetry fields Redwood needs; some of our customers require aggregation only.

linh: For benchmarks I propose: latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput (tokens/s), memory footprint, and tail-latency under load. Two scenarios: interactive chat (2k tokens, prefix caching) and batch embedding (5k vectors).

ada: For press/marketing — marketing requests an embargo buffer. Proposed embargo date is 2026-05-15. We need final numbers and signoff at least 3 weeks prior.

josh: On the SI/integration side: partners will want a runnable quickstart and example manifest for our Dedicated flow. I can spin up a repo and an integration doc.

devon (Driftwood): Telemetry constraints: aggregated KPIs only (no raw request logs). KPIs: p50, p95, tokens_per_second, error_rate. Can you confirm Redwood is OK with aggregated only?

marta: Confirmed — aggregated KPIs only. I uploaded the draft NDA here: https://redwood.example.com/s/nda-driftwood-draft (please annotate by EOD Fri).

ci-bot: ci-bot: added checklist item — "driftwood_lab_onboard.md" required before spinning up dedicated nodes.

kai: Quick perf run command I'll use (putting it here so SIs can reproduce):

```bash
./run_bench.sh --model mpt-10b --quant 8 --seq 2048 --batch 16 --profile-kv-cache
```

kai: Note: quantized paths need a small kernel tweak for native AMP on Driftwood hardware; will include patch notes.

linh: I'll run baseline across both scenarios tomorrow and post a short table. Also recommend we freeze inference config (batching, max_tokens, kv-cache policy) for the official bench so results are comparable.

ada: Marketing needs a final quote & approved quote language by 2026-04-24 to meet the proposed embargo. If NDA completes by 2026-04-05 we can hit that.

devon (Driftwood): :thumbsup: Team committed to NDA sign by 2026-04-05. Staging lab access available from 2026-04-08 for a 2-week soak.

marta: Action items captured: legal review NDA (marta), eng baseline runs (linh & kai), SI quickstart & manifest (josh), marketing timeline & quote (ada). I'll add to the partnership tracker and follow up.

josh: Also adding: SI will need a sample CNF and a minimal infra diagram. I'll draft and share by Fri.

marta: Thanks all. I'll set up a 30-min cadence starting 2026-04-07 to keep the timeline tight and create Asana task 7891 for tracking.
